english: Scott has sent a great many requests for spare parts and other urgent messages from one garage to the other.
text: requests for spare parts 是索要备件的请求，不是已经寄出了备件本身。业务沟通里先分清传递的是物品还是需求：send parts 说寄零件，send a request for parts 说发出要零件的消息。
